newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to drift up, test 129.46.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to drift up, test 129.46.

text.p: June notionnel futures on the MATIF will try to regain some early losses on Thursday, testing initial resistance at 129.46 ahead of minor congestion at 129.70, technical analysts said.
"I think just for today we'll see a gradual drifting higher," said Mike Macdonald, technical analyst at 4CAST here. "But yesterday's high at 130.14 should remain untouched."
By 0800 GMT, the June notionnel was down 28 basis points at 129.30, off an earlier low of 129.08.
Macdonald put initial resistance at Wednesday's low of 129.46.
"We'll probably see a test of that today and a gradual move higher," he said. He added there would be some selling within minor intraday congestion around 129.70.
Macdonald said any break above there would see a minor intra-day top at 129.88.
He put Fibonnaci support at 128.91, the 50 percent retracement from 127.06 on April 4 to 130.76 on May 16.
Beneath there, the next prop is at the April 30 low at 128.76, with a further support at 128.47, the 61.8 percent retracement of the move up. Macdonald said this level would likely hold on Thursday.
Analysts at MCM Yieldwatch said a sustained break through 129.30 resistance opened up a potential move to 129.68 with further gains prompting a test on Wednesday's 130.14 high.
"Down through 129.02 opens 128.94 ahead of 128.76," they said in a client note.
By 0845 GMT, June Pibor was down two basis points at 96.49.
RSI - 14 day -- Notionnel 47.2 pct, Pibor 51.2 pct
